verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents role-based access control, where privileges are granted to roles and roles to users, and clones inherit granted privileges on child objects. That covers object-level access control by role. Nothing in the pack shows column-level masking policies or row-level access policies, which are the core of the story. Access History tracks access to tables and columns, but that is auditing, not enforcement. Missing for 10: column-level masking policies, row-level access policies, explicit table-level grant documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-team isolation.
